'''Zagsm'ith''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologist]]. He hired a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to transport him to [[Xuaquarres]] to locate the legendary [[Graveyard of the Dragons]].
